title: Timeline
markdown:
| Year | Event | Lesson |
|---|---|---|
| about 2500 BC | The abacus, in Mesopotamia | 1.02 |
| 1642 | Pascal's adding machine, the Pascaline | 1.02 |
| 1673 | Leibniz's stepped reckoner multiplies and divides | 1.02 |
| 1703 | Leibniz publishes binary arithmetic | 1.02 |
| 1804 | Jacquard's loom reads patterns from punched cards | 1.02 |
| 1822 | Babbage designs the Difference Engine | 1.02 |
| 1837 | Babbage designs the Analytical Engine, a general-purpose computer | 1.02 |
| 1843 | Ada Lovelace publishes the first program | 1.02 |
| 1854 | George Boole's algebra of logic | 1.02 |
| 1890 | Hollerith's punched-card machines count the US census | 1.02 |
| 1936 | Turing describes the universal machine | 1.03 |
| 1937 | Shannon shows switch circuits follow Boole's logic | 1.02 |
| 1941 | Zuse's Z3, the first working programmable computer | 1.03 |
| 1943-44 | Colossus breaks codes at Bletchley Park | 1.03 |
| 1945 | ENIAC; von Neumann's stored-program report | 1.03 |
| 1947 | The transistor, at Bell Labs; Kathleen Booth's assembly language | 1.04, 5.01 |
| 1948 | The Manchester Baby runs the first stored program | 1.03 |
| 1949 | EDSAC in regular use | 1.03 |
| 1952 | Grace Hopper's A-0 compiler | 5.02 |
| 1957 | FORTRAN | 5.02 |
| 1958 | The integrated circuit (Kilby); Lisp | 1.04, 5.02 |
| 1959 | COBOL | 5.02 |
| 1960 | ALGOL 60 | 5.02 |
| 1963 | ASCII | 3.01 |
| 1964 | BASIC; IBM System/360 settles the 8-bit byte | 5.02, 2.03 |
| 1965 | Moore's law | 1.04 |
| 1967 | Simula introduces objects | 5.05 |
| 1969 | Unix at Bell Labs; ARPANET | 5.04, 6.06 |
| 1971 | Intel 4004, the first microprocessor | 1.04 |
| 1972 | C | 5.04 |
| 1973 | Unix rewritten in C | 5.04 |
| 1975 | Altair 8800; Microsoft | 1.04 |
| 1977 | Apple II | 1.04 |
| 1978 | Intel 8086, the start of x86 | 1.04 |
| 1981 | IBM PC and MS-DOS | 1.04 |
| 1983 | The internet switches to TCP/IP | 6.06 |
| 1984 | Apple Macintosh | 1.04 |
| 1985 | C++; IEEE 754 floating point; Intel 80386 (32-bit); ARM | 5.05, 3.03, 1.04 |
| 1989-91 | The World Wide Web | 6.06 |
| 1991 | Linux; Python; Unicode | 5.04, 5.05, 3.01 |
| 1992 | UTF-8 | 3.01 |
| 1995 | Java; JavaScript | 5.05 |
| 2000 | C# | 5.05 |
| 2003 | x86-64 (AMD64) | 1.04 |
| 2005 | Multi-core CPUs in ordinary PCs | 1.05 |
| 2007 | The iPhone | 1.05 |
| 2008 | Android | 5.04 |
| 2009 | Go | 5.05 |
| 2012 | TypeScript | 5.05 |
| 2014 | Swift | 5.05 |
| 2015 | Rust 1.0 | 5.05 |
| 2017 | WebAssembly | 5.03 |
| 2020 | Apple M1: Macs move to ARM | 1.04 |
| 2038 | Signed 32-bit time runs out | 2.06 |
